title: Greedo
description: Working for Jabba the Hutt, Greedo was a Rodian bounty hunter operating on Tatooine. Despite the fact that no one took him too seriously, he fancied himself a big shot because of who he worked for. When he spotted Han Solo in the Mos Eisley Cantina, he took it upon himself to deliver Jabba's justice to the smuggler in arrears, only to be fried by the ruthless Corellian.
